name: mm-corporate-income-tax
description: Myanmar corporate income tax for the 2026-27 financial year (1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027) under the Union Taxation Law 2026 and the Income Tax Law. Covers the 22% rate for companies, Myanmar Investment Commission businesses, State-owned enterprises and non-resident aliens, 17% for companies listed on the Yangon Stock Exchange, the 20 million kyat exemption for new micro, small and medium enterprises, capital gains, three-year loss carry forward, quarterly advance tax, the 30 June return and penalties. Use for questions about Myanmar company tax, CIT, IRD corporate returns or MSME tax holidays.
